news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 10 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 10 new directors. 2 experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. MD & Executive Director Jatinbhai Shah is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2022. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Shyamkamal Investments Limited Announces Appointment of Aesha Harsh Shah As Additional Non-Executive Independent Director And Reconstitution Of Board Committees, Effective February 11, 2026
news.body: Shyamkamal Investments Limited announces the appointment of Ms. Aesha Harsh Shah as an Additional Non-Executive and Independent Director of the Company with effect from February 11, 2026. Ms. Aesha Shah is an Associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India with a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Business Administration, specializing in Finance and Human Resources. She has extensive experience in Corporate Governance, Company Law, and Secretarial functions, handling key legal compliances, listings, and corporate restructuring. Her expertise and leadership make her a valuable Independent Woman Director for any company. news.title: Morabia Enterprise Private Limited and Mahendra Harajivan Morabia cancelled the acquisition of 26% stake in Shyamkamal Investments Limited (BSE:505515).
news.body:
Morabia Enterprise Private Limited and Mahendra Harajivan Morabia proposed to acquire an additional 26% stake in Shyamkamal Investments Limited (BSE:505515) for INR 130 million on February 25, 2025. A cash consideration valued at INR 10 per share will be paid by Morabia Enterprise Private Limited. Upon completion, Morabia Enterprise Private Limited will own 25.81% stake in Shyamkamal Investments Limited. The transaction will be financed by internal resources of acquirers.

Completion of this Offer and the underlying preferential issue is subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions precedent and the receipt of statutory and other regulatory approvals, as applicable.The tender offer will close on May 13, 2025.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.8% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.1x net interest cover).
